## Question and proposed contribution

- Falsifiable question / specific error condition:
- Why existing user-owned components do not already satisfy this contract:
- Proposed implementation and non-novel algorithms explicitly acknowledged:
- Expected negative result / failure case:

## Prior art and source use

- [ ] Searched user's existing repos, historical experiments and negatives
- [ ] Searched external GitHub implementations, tests, issues and docs
- [ ] Recorded upstream immutable permalinks, overlap and limitations
- [ ] Checked applicable source licenses, file notices and dependency/data terms
- [ ] Declared whether code, text, images, model weights or data were copied/adapted
- [ ] Recorded required attribution, permissions and unresolved ownership/legal questions
- [ ] No claim of novelty based on lack of search matches

## Evidence and authorization

- [ ] Confirmatory protocol frozen **before** outcome access, or labeled EXPLORATORY
- [ ] Positive, negative and mutation/anti-vacuity tests present
- [ ] Raw failures and original evidence preserved (no overwrites)
- [ ] Independent verifier limitations described; hash != authenticity != truth
- [ ] Security/capability and spending boundaries tested separately
- [ ] Model outputs cannot authorize their own execution, policy change or deployment
- [ ] Repository changes and any production effects explicitly reviewed by owner

## Claims review

- **Implemented and checked:**
- **Still hypothetical / NOT VALIDATED:**
- **New third-party code imported (precise origin, version and license):**
- **Potential counterexample that would falsify this PR:**
- **Human reviewer / unresolved blockers:**

> Checking boxes is self-reporting and is not evidence that legal clearance, originality, containment or real-world validity has been established.
